caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair, centrally placed within a rectangular frame on a plain, light beige background. The chair is shown in a three-quarters view, revealing details of its design. The chair has a dark brown wooden frame with a curved top-rail that is accented by three gothic-style arches. The backrest consists of three vertical spindles supporting the arches, connected by a horizontal rail near the seat. The chair seat features a woven cane pattern in light yellow-brown tones. The front legs of the chair are rounded, turned, and slightly tapered, with simple decorative carving, while the rear legs are straighter with a slight outward curve at the feet. Stretchers connect the legs for added support. In the upper left corner of the image, a small sketch of the same chair appears, drawn in fine lines and enclosed within a lightly outlined box. Below the main image, in the bottom right corner, there is handwritten text in a fine script. The overall composition is balanced, with the chair occupying the central area and the details subtly rendered to distinguish wood texture and construction.
title: Cathedral Chair
